# LLM Semantic Extraction

The LLMSemanticExtractor is responsible for extracting semantic information from provided artifacts using a language model. It validates input while managing retries and cache optimizations to enhance performance and resource utilization. This feature ensures that only semantically relevant data is processed and returned.
